title: Uguhamagara Kwahindutse Imyaka
intro: Tekereza umutima wahagaze wenyene urwanya ubutekerezi bwose, wiyemeje kubayobora ngo bave mu nzira mbi bafise umwiyemezo udatezuka. Mu binjana n’ibindi, ubwo butumwa bwaranse, buratwengwa, burakurwaho—yamara rero, utwo twigoro ntitwahagarara. Amaherezo, haraje igiharuro gikomeye, bakeyi gusa ni bo baje mu gakiza iruhande y’uwo mutima ushikamye. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo mubare muri Korowani?
clues: Narungitswe nk’umugabisha ku bantu bazimiye mu nzira zabo bwite.
Narabatumiye ngo barondere imbabazi, bahindukire bave mu bicumuro vyabo, ariko barahindukira.
Nategetswe n’Imana, nubatse ubwato bunini cane mu gihe abantu banje bariko barandaba kandi bantwenga.
Narahamagara Umukama wanje ubudasiba—amaherezo aranyishura, amazi arasuka ava mw’ijuru mu migende.
Narinjiye mu bwato ndi kumwe n’abemera igihe amazi y’umwuzure yaduga hejuru y’igihugu.
Naciye ntakambira umwe yari yasigaye inyuma, ndabasaba ko bohungira ku musozi, ariko itegeko ryari ryaramaze gusohoka.
